note: activity bar -- renders: Explorer, Search, Source Control, Run, Extensions, Accounts, Settings (fixed view-switcher icons and bottom controls)
explorer viewlet title bar -- renders: 'Explorer' heading and More-actions dropdown (fixed operator vocabulary)

explorer pane headers -- renders: Open Editors / Outline / Timeline titles, New File, New Folder, Refresh, Collapse All (fixed operator vocabulary); pane bodies with file tree are siblings, not children, so stay masked
native menu bar -- renders: File, Edit, Selection, View, Go, Run, Terminal, Help (fixed operator vocabulary)

Getting Started page frame -- renders: product name, subtitle, show-on-startup checkbox; the Start/Recent actions column (may show user folder names) and Walkthroughs column (may show extension-contributed content) are subtracted
editor tab toolbar -- renders: Split editor, More actions (fixed operator vocabulary); the tabs themselves show file names and stay masked
status bar notifications item -- renders: 'Notifications' (fixed operator label)
status bar screen-reader-mode indicator -- renders: fixed operator label for accessibility mode
